title.narrative: Industrial Modernization and Upgrading Programme (IMUP) - Phase II

description.narrative: The project is a multi-bilateral between the Italian Government, Syria and UNIDO as the executing agency and funded by Italian Cooperation. It was conceived as a second phase of the successful project "Industrial Modernization an Upgrading Programme" (IMUP-Syria) following (a) request from the Syrian Government presented by State Planning Committee (SPC) on the 26th of October 2008; and (b) a recommendation of the tri-partite independent evaluation of IMUP-Syria Phase I, which took place in Syria between March and May 2009. The objective of the project is to continue strengthening the competitiveness of the manufacturing sector in Syria, taking into acco unt the "Impact of the international economic and financial crisis" which increase the demand for restructuring and upgrading industrial enterprises. Focusing on the textile, garment and agro-food industry value chains, it aims at achieving a positive impact on demand and employment while improving compliance with quality, environmental and social standards.
